name: Computer Use
description: Discover current on-screen context, even without a named app. Operate native apps and OS dialogs. Prefer accessibility or the source's Copy action before OCR for exact text/links. Use browser_use for webpages and browser screenshots.
progressive_guidance:
Use browser_use for webpages, forms, uploads, downloads and JavaScript dialogs. Use this toolkit for native apps, browser chrome and genuine OS controls, then return to browser_use for page work. Browser access and OS permissions require owner action, not GUI workarounds or switching browsers.
When the destination app is unspecified, check cua.list_apps for saved preferred_apps first; consult ACTIVITY.md and LOCAL_INVENTORY.md only if needed. Prefer the owner's explicit choice, then saved preferences, then activity hints. Source links do not determine the destination service.
For coding tasks, hand off to the owner's chosen coding agent; do not write the implementation yourself. Confirm the repository, preserve analysis-only constraints, and inspect the agent's response before summarizing. Terminal ancestry identifies a host app, not an exact tab/pane: locate the correct idle session and never interrupt active work.
Continue in a relevant existing window of the selected app. Do not switch apps merely for a richer backend. Signed-in apps need no API connector; pause for owner login or permission rather than requesting credentials in chat.
Teaching, explaining, translating, summarizing and inspecting are read-only unless changes are requested. Analyze supplied images first and use tools only for missing evidence; never edit fields to understand them.
